items.q: What three axes does Tilbury use to compare side hustles?
items.a: Score each **1–5** on **time to learn**, **startup capital**, and **difficulty reaching $1K/month** (1 = easiest). Thesis: a degree alone won't make you rich — pick hustles that can **scale**.

items.q: What should a student side hustle grow into?
items.a: Something **bigger than pocket money** — Mark's own side hustles became **multimillion-dollar** businesses. Platform creator payouts are **temporary arbitrage**; act before competition and payouts shrink.

items.q: How does faceless short-form actually pay?
items.a: Case: Daniel Bitton (~16) ~**$500K/month** on Snapchat without showing his face. Win with **original remixes**, consistent **hook → payoff** watch time, multiple niche channels. Ratings: Learn **4/5**, Capital **1/5**, $1K/mo **1/5**. Psychology beats fancy editing.

items.q: What's the Discord and coaching playbook?
items.a: Chris Peters: **free value first** → indispensable → paid; **4 × $250/mo** retainers = $1K. Jack Jefferson: fitness coaching hit **$7K/mo** via personalized plans + video check-ins — **personalization beats generic courses**.

items.q: Should students choose investing or a side hustle?
items.a: **Both at once.** Use hustles for fast cash; **DCA ~half** into **index funds** (S&P ~**11%** avg / 10 years). Example: **$200/mo × 40 years @ 10% → $1.2M+**. Learn **1/5**, capital from **$1**.

items.q: Why is AI animation a timing play?
items.a: Mercy earns **$8–10K/month** (ChatGPT scripts + Midjourney). Mark places AI at the **start of the early majority** on Rogers' curve — stand out now before late adopters are forced in. Learn **4/5**, $1K/mo **2/5**.

items.q: What makes luxury resale hard but lucrative?
items.a: Ben Gallagher's Luxe Collective: **£7.2M** (2023); market ~**$39B**. You need **authentication expertise** + capital (Learn **4/5**, Capital **3.5/5**) — one fake mistake ruins reputation; margins can be **one-sale** to $1K.

items.q: How do premium writers charge without racing to the bottom?
items.a: Adam: **$10K+/month** writing blogs/scripts/threads — not novels. Price on **ROI** (examples up to **$50K** for one page if it doubles profit). There's always someone cheaper; not always someone **more expensive**. Bottleneck is **focus/flow**, not capital.
